text:
John (Acme): Hey, post-new rollout our generated Go microservice fails to compile. The generated main.go is missing the DB initialization call (InitDB/Open) so builds fail with undefined symbol at link time. This is blocking our CI and deploys for our tenant. Repro steps + logs below.

Alex (CS): Sorry you're hitting this — escalating to eng oncall. Can you paste the exact prompt you sent and the model id shown in the response headers?

John (Acme): Prompt: "generate a minimal HTTP service in Go with DB setup using sqlx"
Model header: `x-redwood-model: redwood-gen-v2.3.0-canary`
Repro steps:
1) Use prompt above against model redwood-gen-v2.3.0-canary
2) Save output as main.go
3) `go build ./...` -> compile error

Compile output:
```
# example.com/service
./main.go:34:2: undefined: InitDB
./main.go:56:10: undefined: db
```

Generated snippet (from model):
```go
package main
import (
    "net/http"
    "github.com/jmoiron/sqlx"
)
func main(){
    // router setup
    mux := http.NewServeMux()
    mux.HandleFunc("/health", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request){ w.Write([]byte("ok")) })
    http.ListenAndServe(":8080", mux)
}
// missing DB init and db variable entirely
```

deploy-bot: Deploy notice: model redwood-gen-v2.3.0-canary rolled to canary cohort 12 at 2026-03-16T10:23:45Z (canary id: can-12)

Maria (Eng): Thanks — reproducing now with the same prompt and model id. I can confirm the generated file omits any call to open or initialize the DB (no `sqlx.Open` and no `db` variable). Looks like a prompt-template regression that pruned the init block.

Maria (Eng): I'm going to rollback that canary cohort and push a hotfix to the generation template. Will include a unit test that checks for `InitDB`/`db` presence.

John (Acme): Appreciate it. This is blocking our CI; any ETA on rollback?

Amy (Oncall): Initiating rollback to model `redwood-gen-v2.2.7` for can-12 now. Rolling back takes ~2m. Marking P1 and filing CS ticket CS-4721 for follow-up. @Maria can you add a reproducible test case that runs `go build` on generated output?

Maria (Eng): Yes — adding an automated `go vet` + `go build` test in the codegen regression suite and a prompt guard to ensure a DB init snippet is present. For immediate mitigation, the following quick patch fixes the generated main.go: add this snippet near top of file:
```go
var db *sqlx.DB
func initDB(){
    var err error
    db, err = sqlx.Open("pgx", "postgres://user:pass@localhost/dbname")
    if err != nil { panic(err) }
}
// call in main before router setup: initDB()
```

John (Acme): Applied the patch locally and builds succeed. Thank you. Please ping when the permanent fix is live so we can remove the workaround. :white_check_mark:

Alex (CS): Really sorry for the disruption — giving this customer priority credits for the downtime and tracking the follow-up until patch merges. Will post the PR/rollback confirmation here shortly.

Maria (Eng): PR opened: https://git.redwood.infra/codegen/regressions/pulls/142 — includes template fix + test. Rolling back canary completed at 2026-03-16T10:28:12Z.

John (Acme): Confirming CI green after rollback. Thanks everyone.

Amy (Oncall): Closing incident when PR merges and monitors show no further regressions for 24h. :eyes:
